sources.entry: Jellyfin - Media server for audio, video, books, comics, and photos with a sleek interface and robust transcoding capabilities. Almost all modern platforms have clients, including Roku, Android TV, iOS, and Kodi. (Demo, Source Code, Clients) GPL-2.0 C#/deb/Docker

summary.one_liner: An curated awesome-list of plugins, themes, companion apps, and guides for the Jellyfin media server.
summary.what_it_does: This is a link list, not software: it catalogs third-party extensions and tools for Jellyfin, organized into sections for Plugins, Companion Apps & Tools, Guides, Snippets, and a Related section for non-Jellyfin-specific tools. Plugins are grouped by purpose (UI & customization, collections and playlists, playback, integration and sync, notifications, authentication, library management, and metadata providers). Companion apps are grouped into artwork, media requests, statistics, user management, media organization, subtitles, music, content import, and server administration. Each entry has a one-line description, and some carry badges such as JF12 compatibility, Beta, Stale, or Paid. The README also links to a Themes section, a Clients section, and community forums and chat servers.
use_cases: Find a Jellyfin plugin for a specific feature
Customize Jellyfin's home screen, theme, or logo
Sync watch history with Plex, Trakt, or Letterboxd
Add notifications from Jellyfin to Discord or Telegram
Manage users and invitations for a Jellyfin server
Find subtitle, artwork, or metadata tools for Jellyfin
notable: Covers plugins, companion apps, guides, and related tools in one list
Badges flag Jellyfin 12 compatibility, beta, stale, and paid status
Sections for ebooks, music, subtitles, and Discord/Telegram bots
Links to official and community Jellyfin forums and chat
caveats: Entries are third-party projects; quality and maintenance vary, and many are marked Stale
Some listed tools are paid (for example ACdb.tv and tdarr)
keywords: curated list of media server tools
